description: Mineberry server stats API, web dashboard, and logging system built with Node.js.
longDescription: MB refers to Mineberry, a Minecraft server. This project exposes an API for player stats and leaderboards that other tools — like Discord bots — can query, and also serves a website where stats and leaderboards can be viewed directly.
statusNote: This project is archived and no longer maintained. It was developed several years ago and some features, dependencies, or functionality may no longer work as expected. Preserved for reference.
